verdict: Organic signals dropped sharply this week; overdue pipeline work is being resolved.
narrative: Across all three businesses this period, your Google Business Profile listings generated 396 combined actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — with no paid advertising active. Over the last 7 days, GBP engagement fell sharply at every location (61–78%), and the last three days of the period recorded near-zero activity across the board, which is being investigated as a potential listing visibility issue rather than a seasonal fluctuation. In parallel, several CRM and outreach milestones that were due in August and September remain open; resolving these blockers is the immediate priority, as they hold up contact sequences and pipeline data integrity. Site reindexing, contact list pulls, and automated outreach sequences are all in motion with an end-of-October target. Once those foundations are in place, organic recovery will have something to build on.

week-over-week drop in Google Business Profile engagement at every location this period

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement fell to zero across multiple listings for three consecutive days (Oct 15–17), signalling a possible listing visibility problem, not routine slowdown.
watch_item.fix: Listings are under active review this week; site reindexing is in progress and is expected to stabilise search presence by end of October.
